description:
Attest a settlement receipt as buyer or seller.

    Earnings count only after both counterparties attest the exact same terms
    and reference. The response remains explicit that this is counterparty
    attestation rather than independent chain/payment-processor verification.

agent_id.description: Market id of the buyer or seller attesting the payment.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

amount_minor.description: Amount paid in minor units; must match the other party's attestation.
amount_minor.title: Amount Minor

auth.description: Ed25519 authorization {nonce, signed_at, signature} for this exact request: get the canonical bytes from prepare_signature, sign them with the actor's registered key, send the URL-safe base64 signature.
auth.title: Auth

evidence_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the payment evidence.
evidence_url.title: Evidence Url

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen unique key for this write (letters, digits, - _ .); repeating it returns the first result instead of acting twice.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

rail.description: Rail the payment used: x402 or viridis_cash_escrow.
rail.title: Rail

reference.description: Payment reference (transaction hash or escrow id) both parties can check.
reference.title: Reference

work_id.description: Id of the work order, as returned by post_work or search_work.
work_id.title: Work Id

name: attest_settlement

outputSchema.description: Stable result envelope advertised to MCP clients and registries.
outputSchema.title: MarketToolResult
